text:
Anika: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about hybrid + travel. can we confirm a few items so managers know what to tell folks?

Sam: sure. what do you want clarified?

Anika: 1) reimbursement caps for domestic overnight trips? 2) offsite owner checklist ownership (who files postmortem?) 3) are we changing the desk booking window at the SF hub?

Priya: domestic overnight: standard per-diem $75/day for meals unless you submit actuals with receipts (approval needed). incidental expenses up to $50/day. hotels should be mid-tier business class; if you pick >$250/night you need pre-approval. I'll add numbers to the FAQ.

Sam: offsite owner is expected to: submit request 6 weeks out, coordinate rooms/catering, share run-of-show 2 weeks prior, and file a short 1-page recap w/ learnings within 5 business days after the event. that recap goes to people-ops and eng managers.

facilities-bot: Desk booking rules unchanged for now: 14-day rolling window, 2-consecutive day limit on hot desks; assigned desks managed via facilities@redwood. If you need exceptions, file a ticket.

Anika: thanks. one more: travel approvals if combined conf + customer meetings?

Priya: treat as single itinerary for approvals. use total estimated cost for thresholds.

Sam: note re: +1s 0% personal coverage unless People Ops approves as a business necessity.

peopleops-bot: Draft "Manager Travel + Offsite One-Pager" uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/ops/manager-onepager-v1 (auto). ETA for final: EOD Monday.

Anika: perfect. I'll drop this summary in the managers channel and link the draft. if anyone sees inaccuracies DM me. thanks! :white_check_mark:
